## 🛹 About
This resource pack adds a Russian translation for [I Wanna Skate](https://modrinth.com/mod/i-wanna-skate) mod by Alex668 and Crydigo
## 📰 Permissions & FAQ
You are allowed to include this resource pack in videos and modpacks as long as download link leads to this modrinth page.
## 💡 Afterword
If you have any suggestions or corrections, feel free to talk about them! Have a nice game!
